summary: A 20-level book that does not come within Dhan's timeout (30 s, shortened here) falls back to the market feed's full packet and its five levels, as the web's fallback monitor does.

notes: dhan_adapter.py:409-412 (a 30 s timeout per 20-level subscription) and 972-1066 (the monitor moves it to the 5-level socket).
